project_name: Bayesian Optimization and Design of Experiments for Pharmaceutical Formulation (BODoE)
summary: This industry-led project proposed coupling BO-driven design of experiments with an automated laboratory for the formulation of pharmaceutical drug compounds as multi-component mixtures, defining the data schemas and interfaces linking laboratory devices, property-prediction services such as COSMO-SAC\cite{mqs_cosmo_2024}, and the optimization loop. The submission stayed at the proposal stage: no code or results were published.
